what: Vendor verifier ci-local-unfixable bail is not routed to exit 3
scenario_or_breakage: The plan has _verify_failed_jobs_locally set BAIL_REASON=ci-local-unfixable:* and return 1 through run_ci_fix_vendor, but run_evaluate_failure only exits 3 for first-fixer-non-health; the next outer attempt clears BAIL_REASON at scripts/ship-pr.sh:2066 and eventual exhaustion becomes a stall, so the planned vendor_verify_local_exhausts test would not pass and the main agent never sees the uniform ci-local-unfixable surface
suggested_fix: Add explicit run_evaluate_failure handling after vendor_rc is captured: if vendor_rc is nonzero and BAIL_REASON matches ci-local-unfixable:* then exit 3 before retry/backoff, or return a distinct rc from run_ci_fix_vendor and case it to exit 3; keep first-fixer-non-health handling intact
